en.t: The man stayed seated all the way to the last stop.

units.source_text: 一下汽车，眼前便是崎岖不平、坑坑洼洼的一片。

en.t: As soon as he got off the bus, a rough, pitted stretch of ground lay before his eyes.

units.source_text: 低洼的地方，被分割成一小块一小块的水田，

en.t: The low-lying places had been divided into small patches of rice paddies,

units.source_text: 稍高出一点的地方是柿子田，像小岛一样散布在水田之间。

en.t: while the slightly higher ground was planted with persimmon fields, scattered among the paddies like little islands.

units.source_text: 男人不闻不问径直穿过村子，

en.t: Without asking or paying attention to anything, the man went straight through the village,

units.source_text: 接着，再往村子后边白茫茫萧瑟枯索的海边走去。

en.t: and then continued toward the desolate, bleak white seashore behind it.
